name: VPlay Telegram Bot
description: Telegram bot that plays user-provided video/audio directly in a group's video chat — no YouTube/cookies needed. Full controls: pause, resume, skip, seek, queue.

API_ID.description: my.telegram.org se milega (API Development Tools) — dono bot aur assistant account isi API_ID ko use karte hain.

API_HASH.description: my.telegram.org se milega, API_ID ke sath hi.

BOT_TOKEN.description: @BotFather se /newbot karke banaya hua bot token.

SESSION_STRING.description: generate_session.py chala kar (locally) banaya gaya assistant/userbot session string. Ye account jis bhi group me video chalana hai wahan admin hona chahiye.

OWNER_ID.description: Aapki apni Telegram numeric user ID (e.g. @userinfobot se pata karein). Owner hamesha commands use kar sakta hai.

ADMIN_ONLY_MODE.description: Default false: group ka har member vplay/vskip/vstop use kar sakta hai. true karne par sirf group admins.

ASSISTANT_FALLBACK.description: true: agar bot ko group me command nahi milta to assistant account khud command chala dega.

STARTUP_NOTIFY.description: true: har start par OWNER_ID ko bot DM bhejega.

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Log group/channel ID (e.g. -100...). Bot wahan admin ho.
